purpose: Use public insurance-domain knowledge to identify review dimensions and generate hypotheses or clarification questions without asserting undocumented client rules.

usagePolicy.confidentiality: Contains only public-domain abstractions and original generic review questions. Do not add client names, fields, thresholds, workflows, rating logic, or proprietary documents.

sources.title: The Business Analysis Standard
sources.usageNote: Used for original abstractions of requirement verification, validation, stakeholder, context, scope, and traceability dimensions.

sources.title: Property & Casualty Data Standards
sources.usageNote: Uses only publicly listed business-case and transaction taxonomy. Does not reproduce licensed schemas, messages, fields, or specification text.

sources.title: Cloud API products and lines of business
sources.usageNote: Used as a non-universal example of product, line of business, coverable, coverage, and product-model capabilities.

sources.title: Overview of policy transaction management
sources.usageNote: Used to identify common transaction stages such as initiate, modify, quote, bind, issue, withdraw, and cancel.

sources.title: Submissions
sources.usageNote: Used to identify generic quote input, risk information, re-draft, rating, multi-version, and override review dimensions.

sources.title: Overview of policy contacts
sources.usageNote: Used to identify generic account contacts, policy contacts, contextual roles, and line-of-business-specific roles.

sources.title: Initiating a renewal
sources.usageNote: Used to identify generic automated and manual renewal, change, requote, underwriting, and pre-renewal review dimensions.

sources.title: Out-of-sequence conflicts
sources.usageNote: Used to identify effective-dated concurrency and out-of-sequence policy-change risks.

sources.title: Underwriting issues in PolicyCenter
sources.usageNote: Used to identify generic referral, blocking point, approval, lock, and renewal-referral review dimensions.

sources.title: Producers
sources.usageNote: Used to identify generic producer organization, producer code, commission plan, and access-scope dimensions.

sources.title: 互联网保险业务监管办法
sources.publisher: 国家金融监督管理总局
sources.usageNote: Used only as a China-jurisdiction example for end-to-end service, traceability, consumer protection, and process-control review; applicability must be confirmed.

sources.title: Insurance Core Principle 19: Conduct of Business
sources.usageNote: Used for high-level fair-treatment, intermediary, disclosure, and conduct-of-business review dimensions; not used as detailed system rules.

modules.description: 所有需求默认执行的事实、范围、状态、异常和验收完整性检查。

checks.checkZh: 是否说明要解决的业务问题、目标结果和成功标准？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What business problem and measurable outcome should this requirement achieve?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确发起者、操作人、审批人、受影响方和结果接收方？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which actors initiate, perform, approve, and receive the outcome of this process?

checks.checkZh: 是否同时说明当前行为、期望行为以及需要保持不变的行为？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What is the current behaviour, what should change, and what must remain unchanged?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确执行前需要满足的状态、数据、权限和时间条件？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What status, data, permissions, and timing conditions must be satisfied before this action is allowed?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确适用和不适用的交易类型，例如新保、续保、批改、撤单和复效？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which transaction types are in scope and out of scope, such as New Business, Renewal, Policy Change, Cancellation, and Reinstatement?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确险种、产品、渠道、客户类型和司法辖区范围？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which products, lines of business, channels, customer segments, and jurisdictions are in scope?

checks.checkZh: 是否定义允许的起始状态、成功状态、拒绝状态、撤回状态及不可逆动作？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What are the allowed starting states, resulting states, rejection states, withdrawal states, and irreversible actions?

checks.checkZh: 是否覆盖校验失败、外部服务失败、超时、重复请求、部分成功和人工接管？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What should happen for validation failures, external-service failures, timeouts, duplicate requests, partial success, and manual intervention?

checks.checkZh: 是否存在可验证的正常、边界、异常、权限和数据一致性验收条件？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What testable acceptance criteria cover the happy path, boundaries, exceptions, permissions, and data consistency?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确性能、容量、可用性、可访问性、可追溯性和数据留存要求？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What performance, volume, availability, accessibility, traceability, and retention requirements apply?

modules.description: 保险产品、险种、保障、风险对象、责任条款、版本和可用性配置。

checks.checkZh: 是否明确产品、险种以及单险种或组合险产品结构？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which product and lines of business are affected, and is the product mono-line or multi-line?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确配置版本、生效日期、失效日期以及存量保单适用方式？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which product version and effective dates apply, and how should existing policies be treated?

checks.checkZh: 是否定义保障责任在产品、司法辖区、渠道、客户和风险条件下的可用性？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Under which product, jurisdiction, channel, customer, and risk conditions is the coverage available?

checks.checkZh: 是否区分必选、默认、建议、可选和互斥保障？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which coverages are required, defaulted, suggested, optional, or mutually exclusive?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确责任限额、免赔额、选项值、默认值、币种和组合限制？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What limits, deductibles, option values, defaults, currencies, and combination constraints apply?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确风险对象、层级关系、必填属性、数量限制和数据校验？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which risk objects and attributes are required, how are they related, and what validation or cardinality rules apply?

checks.checkZh: 产品配置是否依赖资格规则、核保规则、问题集或外部数据？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which eligibility rules, underwriting rules, question sets, or external data determine product availability?

checks.checkZh: 产品变化是否需要同步费率表、因子、折扣、附加费或税费配置？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Does this product change require updates to rates, factors, discounts, surcharges, fees, or taxes?

checks.checkZh: 是否定义产品、保障和交易阶段与条款、批单及客户文件的映射？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which policy forms, endorsements, clauses, and customer documents are associated with this product configuration and transaction stage?

checks.checkZh: 产品版本变化是否影响在途报价、存量保单、续保、批改和历史可重现性？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How should the change affect in-flight quotes, existing policies, renewals, endorsements, and historical reproducibility?

modules.description: 个人、组织、账户、保单联系人、角色、关系、标识和隐私。

checks.checkZh: 是否明确参与方是个人、组织、内部用户、中介机构或其他实体？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which party types are supported, such as person, organisation, internal user, or intermediary?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确同一参与方在账户、报价、保单和险种层面的不同角色？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which roles can the same party hold at account, quote, policy, and line-of-business level?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确主被保险人、附加被保险人、投保人、付款人、受益人、经纪人等必需角色？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which party roles are mandatory, such as primary insured, additional insured, applicant, payer, beneficiary, or producer?

checks.checkZh: 是否说明参与方的唯一标识、匹配、去重、合并和误合并恢复规则？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are parties uniquely identified, matched, deduplicated, merged, and restored after an incorrect merge?

checks.checkZh: 是否定义个人与组织、账户、保单及其他参与方之间的关系和关系有效期？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What relationships connect parties to organisations, accounts, policies, and other parties, and are those relationships effective-dated?

checks.checkZh: 地址和联系方式变更是全局更新、仅当前账户更新还是保单快照更新？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Should an address or contact change update the master party, the current account, the policy snapshot, or selected records only?

checks.checkZh: 角色新增、变更和终止是否需要生效日期、审批和历史记录？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Do party-role additions, changes, and removals require effective dates, approval, and history?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确个人信息用途、授权、可见范围、脱敏、删除和留存要求？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What consent, purpose limitation, visibility, masking, deletion, and retention rules apply to personal data?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确客户、经纪人、供应商和主数据系统标识的来源及映射？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which systems own party identifiers and how are customer, producer, vendor, and master-data identifiers mapped?

checks.checkZh: 经纪人或代理人可查看和操作哪些账户、报价、保单和交易？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which accounts, quotes, policies, and transactions may each producer or intermediary view and operate?

modules.description: 保险人与经纪人、代理人、合作方或其他主体之间的协议、授权和商业条件。

checks.checkZh: 是否明确协议类型及其业务目的，例如代理、经纪、授权承保、佣金或服务协议？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What type of agreement is involved, such as agency, brokerage, binding authority, commission, or service agreement?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确协议各方、签约角色、责任主体和联系人？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Who are the agreement parties, signatory roles, accountable owners, and operational contacts?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确可报价、承保、签发、批改、取消或处理理赔的授权范围？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What authority does the agreement grant for quoting, underwriting, binding, issuing, endorsing, cancelling, or handling claims?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确协议适用的产品、险种、地区、渠道、客户群和币种？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which products, lines of business, territories, channels, customer segments, and currencies are covered by the agreement?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确协议生效、到期、续签、版本替换及存量业务处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What are the agreement effective, expiry, renewal, and supersession rules, and how are existing policies treated?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确佣金、费用、税费、分层比例、覆盖范围和人工调整权限？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What commission, fee, tax, tier, scope, and manual-adjustment terms apply?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确保额、保费、风险等级等授权阈值及超限后的转人工流程？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What authority limits apply and what referral process is required when a limit is exceeded?

checks.checkZh: 协议暂停、终止或失效后，在途报价、保单服务、续保和佣金如何处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What happens to in-flight quotes, policy servicing, renewals, and commission when an agreement is suspended, terminated, or expires?

checks.checkZh: 协议创建、修改、特批和终止是否需要审批、原因、附件和审计记录？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which approvals, reasons, documents, and audit evidence are required to create, amend, override, or terminate an agreement?

checks.checkZh: 多个协议、佣金计划或授权范围同时适用时，是否定义优先级和冲突处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are precedence and conflicts resolved when multiple agreements, commission plans, or authority scopes apply?

modules.description: 报价或投保申请的创建、补充风险信息、计费、比较、接受、失效和重新报价。

checks.checkZh: 报价能力是否明确适用于新保、续保、批改或其他交易？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Does this quotation behaviour apply to New Business, Renewal, Policy Change, or other transaction types?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确开始报价和完成报价所需的客户、风险、保障、历史和外部数据？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which customer, risk, coverage, history, and external data are required to start and complete a quote?

checks.checkZh: 是否定义草稿、可报价、已报价、已接受、已拒绝、已撤回和已失效等状态及转换？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which quote states and transitions apply, including draft, quotable, quoted, accepted, declined, withdrawn, and expired?

checks.checkZh: 是否允许同一业务存在多个报价版本，如何比较、选择、锁定和作废？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Can multiple quote versions exist, and how are they compared, selected, locked, superseded, and invalidated?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确哪些风险、保障、日期、参与方和财务字段变化必须重新计算保费？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which changes to risk, coverage, dates, parties, and financial fields must trigger premium recalculation?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确基础保费、折扣、附加费、税费、佣金和总保费的展示及舍入？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How should base premium, discounts, surcharges, taxes, fees, commission, totals, and rounding be calculated and displayed?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确报价有效期、费率锁定日期、时区以及到期后的重新报价规则？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What quote-validity, rate-lock, date, timezone, expiry, and requote rules apply?

checks.checkZh: 报价接受后哪些修改会使接受失效并要求客户重新接受？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which changes after quote acceptance invalidate the acceptance and require the customer or broker to accept again?

checks.checkZh: 核保问题在哪些阶段阻止报价、接受、承保或签发，解除后是否自动继续？
checks.clientQuestionEn: At which stages do underwriting issues block quoting, acceptance, binding, or issuance, and what happens after resolution?

checks.checkZh: 费率或保费调整由谁发起、审批，适用范围如何确定，是否需要原因和审计？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Who may request and approve rating or premium overrides, what scope applies, and what reason and audit evidence are required?

checks.checkZh: 多人或多个渠道同时修改报价时，如何锁定、检测冲突和保留版本？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How should concurrent quote edits across users and channels be locked, detected, resolved, and versioned?

checks.checkZh: 计费或外部数据失败时，报价状态、重试、缓存结果和人工处理如何定义？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What should happen to quote status, retry, cached results, and manual handling when rating or external-data services fail?

modules.description: 核保规则、问题、Referral、权限、审批、阻断点和例外处理。

checks.checkZh: 是否明确哪些数据或变化会触发核保问题、警告或转人工？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which data values or changes trigger an underwriting issue, warning, or referral?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确核保规则来源、版本、生效日期以及历史交易使用的版本？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which underwriting-rule source, version, and effective date apply, including for historical or in-flight transactions?

checks.checkZh: 核保问题是提示性还是阻断性，在报价、承保、签发或续保哪个阶段阻断？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Is each underwriting issue informational or blocking, and at which stage does it block quoting, binding, issuance, or renewal?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确不同保费、保额、风险等级、产品和渠道对应的审批权限？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which authority levels apply by premium, limit, risk grade, product, channel, and requested action?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确转人工对象、队列、分配规则、优先级、SLA和升级路径？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are referrals assigned, prioritised, timed, reassigned, and escalated?

checks.checkZh: 核保人员做决定前需要哪些数据、附件、外部查询和解释？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which data, documents, external checks, and explanations are required before an underwriting decision?

checks.checkZh: 是否定义同意、拒绝、有条件同意、加费、除外和补充资料等结果及后续动作？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which decision outcomes are supported, such as approve, decline, approve with conditions, load, exclude, or request more information?

checks.checkZh: 风险信息、保障、保费或日期变化后，哪些核保结果必须重新评估或失效？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which changes require underwriting rules to be re-evaluated or previous approvals to be invalidated?

checks.checkZh: 谁可以覆盖核保结果，覆盖范围、有效期、理由和二次审批如何定义？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Who may override an underwriting outcome, for what scope and duration, and what reason or secondary approval is required?

checks.checkZh: 核保问题、评论、决定和审批是否完整留痕，并在续保或后续交易中复用？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are underwriting issues, comments, decisions, and approvals audited and carried into renewal or later transactions?

modules.description: 保单承保、签发、期间、状态、快照、服务和历史版本。

checks.checkZh: 是否明确保单号、保单期间、版本、交易号和外部标识的生成及唯一性？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are policy number, policy period, version, transaction identifier, and external identifiers generated and kept unique?

checks.checkZh: 是否定义草稿、已报价、已承保、已签发、生效、到期、取消和失效等状态？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which policy lifecycle states and transitions are supported from draft through expiry, cancellation, or lapse?

checks.checkZh: 承保和签发前必须满足哪些核保、付款、文件、数据和授权条件？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which underwriting, payment, document, data, and authority conditions must be met before binding and issuance?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确保险期间、交易日期、生效日期、签发日期、时区和日期边界？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are policy term, transaction date, effective date, issue date, timezone, and date boundaries defined?

checks.checkZh: 签发时哪些产品、参与方、风险、保障、费率和协议数据需要形成不可变快照？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which product, party, risk, coverage, rating, and agreement data must be snapshotted at issuance?

checks.checkZh: 是否定义保单层、险种层、风险对象层和参与方层数据的一致性规则？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What consistency rules apply across policy, line, risk-object, coverage, and party data?

checks.checkZh: 保单有效期间允许查看、修改、补充、下载或更正哪些信息，由谁操作？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which policy information may be viewed, corrected, supplemented, downloaded, or changed in force, and by whom?

checks.checkZh: 保单服务变化是否影响在途批改、续保、取消、复效或理赔？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How should policy servicing changes interact with in-flight endorsements, renewals, cancellations, reinstatements, or claims?

checks.checkZh: 能否按任意日期重现当时有效的保单、保障、参与方、保费和文件？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Must users be able to reconstruct the policy, coverages, parties, premium, and documents as of a historical date?

checks.checkZh: 承保、签发和保单变化后，哪些系统、事件、文件和通知需要同步？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which systems, events, documents, and notifications must be updated after binding, issuance, or policy change?

modules.description: 保单批改、风险或保障变化、生效日期、重算、顺序冲突和批单文件。

checks.checkZh: 是否明确哪些保单状态、产品、交易类型和用户允许发起批改？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which policy states, products, transaction types, and users are eligible to initiate an endorsement?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确可修改和不可修改的风险、保障、参与方、日期、财务和协议字段？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which risk, coverage, party, date, financial, and agreement fields may or may not be changed?

checks.checkZh: 是否需要批改类型、原因、说明、附件及其对应的校验或审批？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which endorsement type, reason, explanation, and supporting evidence are required, and what validation or approval depends on them?

checks.checkZh: 批改可选择哪些生效日期，是否允许追溯、未来生效或超出保单期间？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which endorsement effective dates are allowed, including retrospective, future-dated, or dates outside the current policy term?

checks.checkZh: 哪些批改触发保费重算，如何计算日比例、最低保费、费用、税费和舍入？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which endorsement changes trigger premium recalculation, and how are proration, minimum premium, fees, taxes, and rounding handled?

checks.checkZh: 已有收款时，追加保费、退款、冲销、分期计划和失败支付如何处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: If payment already exists, how should additional premium, refund, reversal, instalments, and failed payments be handled?

checks.checkZh: 批改或保费变化后是否需要客户、经纪人或保险人重新接受或签署？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which endorsement or premium changes require renewed acceptance, consent, or signature from the customer, producer, or insurer?

checks.checkZh: 哪些变化重新触发核保，之前的审批、覆盖或锁定是否失效？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which endorsement changes re-trigger underwriting and invalidate previous approvals, overrides, or locks?

checks.checkZh: 当交易日期晚但生效日期更早时，如何检测、展示和解决顺序冲突？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How should out-of-sequence endorsements be detected, presented, resolved, and audited?

checks.checkZh: 存在在途或已绑定续保时，批改是否以及如何同步到续保版本？
checks.clientQuestionEn: When a renewal is in progress or already bound, should endorsement changes be applied to the renewal, and how?

checks.checkZh: 批改完成后需要生成、替换、作废和发送哪些批单、保单文件及通知？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which endorsement forms, policy documents, obsolete documents, and notifications must be generated, replaced, invalidated, or sent?

checks.checkZh: 批改在草稿、已报价、已接受或已绑定阶段能否撤回，撤回后如何回滚？
checks.clientQuestionEn: At which stages may an endorsement be withdrawn, and how are data, premium, payments, documents, and downstream messages rolled back?

modules.description: 续保发起、数据带入、重新报价、核保、决定、非续保和与其他交易的交互。

checks.checkZh: 需求是否明确适用于续保，还是仅适用于新保、批改或其他交易？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Does this requirement apply to Renewal, or only to New Business, Policy Change, or other transactions?

checks.checkZh: 续保何时自动或人工发起，提前期、时区、失败重试和重复发起如何处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: When is renewal initiated automatically or manually, and how are lead time, timezone, retry, and duplicate initiation handled?

checks.checkZh: 哪些保单、风险、保障、参与方、协议和核保数据带入续保，哪些必须重新确认？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which policy, risk, coverage, party, agreement, and underwriting data are carried forward, recalculated, or re-confirmed at renewal?

checks.checkZh: 产品、费率、条款、规则或法规版本变化时，续保使用哪个版本并如何迁移？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which product, rate, wording, rule, and regulatory versions apply at renewal, and how are changes migrated?

checks.checkZh: 续保是否重新获取风险信息、损失记录、付款记录、外部数据和核保结果？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which risk, loss, payment, external-data, and underwriting information must be refreshed for renewal?

checks.checkZh: 续保报价的生成、版本、有效期、修改、重新报价和接受规则是否明确？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are renewal quotes generated, versioned, modified, requoted, accepted, and expired?

checks.checkZh: 续保触发哪些自动规则、预续保指令、转人工和阻断条件？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which automated rules, pre-renewal directions, referrals, approvals, and blocking conditions apply?

checks.checkZh: 是否区分续保、非续保、客户不接受、撤回、过期和人工待处理结果？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which renewal outcomes are supported, such as renew, non-renew, not taken, withdrawn, expired, or pending manual review?

checks.checkZh: 非续保由谁决定，需要哪些原因、审批、通知期限、证据和司法辖区检查？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Who may decide non-renewal, and what reason, approval, notice period, evidence, and jurisdiction checks are required?

checks.checkZh: 续保期间发生批改时，变化是否复制到续保，是否需要重新报价和重新审批？
checks.clientQuestionEn: If a policy change occurs during renewal, should it be copied to the renewal and trigger requote or re-approval?

checks.checkZh: 续保接受后何时收款、承保、签发并生成续保文件，失败时如何处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: After renewal acceptance, when are payment, binding, issuance, and renewal documents completed, and what happens on failure?

checks.checkZh: 原保单到期而续保尚未完成时，保障连续性、宽限期、状态和通知如何定义？
checks.clientQuestionEn: If the original policy expires before renewal completes, how are continuity of cover, grace period, status, and notification handled?

modules.description: 取消、退保、撤销和复效交易的资格、日期、财务及恢复规则。

checks.checkZh: 哪些保单状态、用户和原因允许发起取消、退保或复效？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which policy states, users, and reasons allow cancellation, surrender, rescission, or reinstatement?

checks.checkZh: 生效日期、追溯限制、通知期限、冷静期和司法辖区规则是否明确？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What effective-date, backdating, notice-period, cooling-off, and jurisdiction rules apply?

checks.checkZh: 是否要求标准原因、自由文本、证明、审批和特批？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which standard reason, explanation, evidence, approval, and override are required?

checks.checkZh: 如何计算短期费率、按日比例、手续费、退款、欠款和佣金冲回？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are short-rate or pro-rata premium, fees, refunds, outstanding balances, and commission clawback calculated?

checks.checkZh: 复效需要满足哪些付款、核保、时间、无损失声明和审批条件？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which payment, underwriting, timing, no-loss declaration, and approval conditions are required for reinstatement?

checks.checkZh: 取消与复效之间是否存在保障中断，如何在保单、理赔和文件中体现？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Is there a coverage gap between cancellation and reinstatement, and how is it represented in policy, claims, and documents?

checks.checkZh: 存在批改、续保或理赔时，取消和复效交易如何协调？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How should cancellation and reinstatement interact with in-flight endorsements, renewals, or claims?

checks.checkZh: 需要生成、作废和发送哪些通知、退款文件、取消凭证和复效凭证？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which notices, refund documents, cancellation evidence, reinstatement evidence, and obsolete documents must be generated or sent?

modules.description: 应收、实收、退款、分期、税费、佣金、币种、舍入和对账。

checks.checkZh: 哪些报价、承保、签发、批改、续保或取消事件创建、调整或冲销应收？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which quote, bind, issue, endorsement, renewal, or cancellation events create, adjust, or reverse receivables?

checks.checkZh: 保费变化时如何计算追加应收、退款、贷项、借项和最低金额？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How should premium differences create additional charge, refund, credit, debit, or minimum-amount treatment?

checks.checkZh: 已有全额、部分或超额收款时，后续保费变化如何处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How should a premium change be handled when payment is already full, partial, overpaid, failed, or in dispute?

checks.checkZh: 保费变化是否重算分期计划、到期日、首付款和未来扣款？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Does a premium change recalculate instalments, due dates, deposit, and future collections?

checks.checkZh: 税费、手续费、折扣、币种转换和各层级舍入规则是否明确？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which tax, fee, discount, currency-conversion, and rounding rules apply at each calculation level?

checks.checkZh: 退款方式、收款账户、审批、反欺诈、失败处理和时限是否明确？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What refund method, destination, approval, fraud control, failure handling, and timing apply?

checks.checkZh: 佣金计划、经纪人代码、计算基础、确认时点、覆盖和冲回规则是否明确？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which commission plan, producer code, calculation base, recognition point, override, and clawback rules apply?

checks.checkZh: 交易日期、生效日期、过账日期、会计期间和关账后的处理是否明确？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are transaction date, effective date, posting date, accounting period, and closed-period adjustments handled?

checks.checkZh: 核心、计费、支付和总账之间如何核对，差异由谁处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are policy, billing, payment, and ledger records reconciled, and who handles exceptions?

checks.checkZh: 重复事件、重试或回放是否会重复收费、退款或佣金？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How is idempotency enforced so retries or replay do not duplicate charges, refunds, or commission?

modules.description: 报价、保单、批单、续保及其他文件的模板、生成、发送和归档。

checks.checkZh: 在哪个业务阶段和状态生成报价单、保单、批单、通知或凭证？
checks.clientQuestionEn: At which business stage and status should each quote, policy, endorsement, notice, or certificate be generated?

checks.checkZh: 模板是否按产品、险种、司法辖区、交易类型、渠道和语言选择？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How is the document template selected by product, line, jurisdiction, transaction type, channel, and language?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确模板版本、生效日期、历史重印版本和替换规则？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which template version and effective date apply, including historical reprint and supersession rules?

checks.checkZh: 数据或保费变化后哪些文件重新生成，旧文件如何标记失效并防止误用？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which changes regenerate documents, and how are prior documents marked obsolete and prevented from further use?

checks.checkZh: 文件通过哪些渠道发送给哪些收件人，失败、退信、重发和偏好如何处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which recipients and delivery channels apply, and how are preference, failure, bounce, and resend handled?

checks.checkZh: 哪些文件需要接受、确认或电子签署，签署顺序和过期如何处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which documents require acceptance, acknowledgement, or electronic signature, in what order, and with what expiry?

checks.checkZh: 文件中的参与方、保障、限额、保费、日期和条款数据来源是否明确且可重现？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which sources populate party, coverage, limit, premium, date, and wording data, and must the output be reproducible?

checks.checkZh: 文件保留多久、谁可查看、是否防篡改，以及历史版本如何检索？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How long are documents retained, who may access them, how is tampering prevented, and how are historical versions retrieved?

modules.description: 保单类需求对承保快照、在途理赔、保障判断和损失记录的潜在影响检查。

checks.checkZh: 理赔判断使用出险日、报案日还是当前保单版本，是否需要历史保障快照？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which policy version and coverage snapshot should claims use based on loss date, report date, or current date?

checks.checkZh: 保单、参与方、风险或保障变化是否以及如何影响在途赔案？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Should a policy, party, risk, or coverage change affect existing claims, and if so, how?

checks.checkZh: 追溯批改、取消或复效是否允许改变已发生事故的保障判断，需何种审批？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Can a retrospective endorsement, cancellation, or reinstatement change coverage for an existing loss, and what approval is required?

checks.checkZh: 新增或更新的损失记录何时反馈到报价、核保和续保？
checks.clientQuestionEn: When and how should new or updated loss history feed quoting, underwriting, and renewal?

checks.checkZh: 保单交易是否需要通知理赔系统，理赔变化是否需要通知保单或续保流程？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which policy transactions notify claims, and which claim changes notify policy or renewal processes?

checks.checkZh: 保单变化是否保留理赔当时使用的数据和决定依据，避免历史被覆盖？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How is the policy and decision evidence used by claims preserved so later changes do not overwrite history?

modules.description: 系统边界、数据归属、接口、事件、映射、时序、错误和数据质量。

checks.checkZh: 是否明确每类客户、产品、报价、保单、财务和文件数据的权威系统？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which system is the source of truth for customer, product, quote, policy, financial, and document data?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确同步或异步接口、触发事件、请求响应、版本和兼容性？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which synchronous APIs or asynchronous events apply, including trigger, contract version, and compatibility?

checks.checkZh: 跨系统客户、报价、保单、交易、支付和文件标识如何映射与追踪？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are customer, quote, policy, transaction, payment, and document identifiers mapped and traced across systems?

checks.checkZh: 是否定义重复请求、重复事件、重试和回放的幂等处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are duplicate requests, duplicate events, retries, and replay made idempotent?

checks.checkZh: 乱序、并发、延迟和旧版本消息如何检测和处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are out-of-order, concurrent, delayed, and stale-version messages detected and handled?

checks.checkZh: 接口失败、部分成功、超时和下游不可用时，重试、补偿、死信和人工修复如何处理？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are retry, compensation, dead-letter handling, reconciliation, and manual repair managed for failure or partial success?

checks.checkZh: 产品、险种、保障、状态、原因、国家、币种等代码如何映射和版本化？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are product, LOB, coverage, status, reason, country, currency, and other reference codes mapped and versioned?

checks.checkZh: 是否定义完整性、准确性、及时性、一致性校验，以及监控、告警和对账？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency, monitoring, alerting, and reconciliation controls are required?

modules.description: 访问控制、职责分离、隐私、安全、审计、留存和司法辖区适用性。

checks.checkZh: 是否明确谁能查看、创建、修改、报价、审批、承保、签发、取消和导出？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which roles may view, create, edit, quote, approve, bind, issue, cancel, and export this information?

checks.checkZh: 发起、审批、特批、付款和退款是否需要职责分离或双人复核？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which initiation, approval, override, payment, and refund actions require segregation of duties or dual control?

checks.checkZh: 个人信息、健康信息、财务信息和内部核保意见对哪些角色可见，是否需要脱敏？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which roles may view personal, health, financial, and internal underwriting data, and what masking is required?

checks.checkZh: 是否记录操作者、时间、前后值、原因、来源渠道、审批和关联交易？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Must the audit trail capture actor, timestamp, before and after values, reason, source channel, approval, and related transaction?

checks.checkZh: 人工覆盖是否要求权限、原因、证据、时限、通知和复核？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What permission, reason, evidence, duration, notification, and review controls apply to manual overrides?

checks.checkZh: 业务数据、文件、日志和个人信息的保留、归档、冻结和删除要求是否明确？
checks.clientQuestionEn: What retention, archive, legal hold, and deletion rules apply to business data, documents, logs, and personal information?

checks.checkZh: 客户、经纪人、代理人和合作方的访问范围、授权、撤权和会话安全是否明确？
checks.clientQuestionEn: How are access scope, authorisation, revocation, and session security controlled for customers, producers, intermediaries, and partners?

checks.checkZh: 是否明确适用司法辖区、客户告知、同意、可回溯和公平对待要求？
checks.clientQuestionEn: Which jurisdiction, disclosure, consent, traceability, and fair-treatment requirements apply?
